parsed.notes:
About you defaults to required; Nice to have makes its two bullets optional. The general invitation to apply without meeting every point does not change those labels.
Only candidate qualifications were labeled; responsibility-only techniques were excluded.
Group 2 also accepts machine learning on tabular or behavioural data, which has no matching taxonomy entry. Group 3 also accepts unmapped multimodal models.
Fraud detection and content classification are treated literally as technical applications; general Trust & Safety knowledge is excluded as domain knowledge.
Care for data privacy is treated literally as a required privacy practice, not as a request for broader cybersecurity expertise.
Practical experience and project ownership do not establish seniority under the guide. No German or degree requirement is stated.
